Facsimile Images

Apparatus criticus

  • Text based on autopsy;
  • 1: Theoretically DIV is also possible, but would be very compressed.

English translation

Jonathan Prag

commentary

There is no immediate monumental context in the ex Giardina Spagna area with which this monumental text could be readily associated, but the area is very close to the Amphitheatre and other structures, and there were several sanctuaries in the vicinity also. The fragment is unpublished.
